findings: Global text style coexists with six independent style range lists; precedence is not established by the data class.
alignment field serializes as t8 with alternate name lineSpace, while rowSpace serializes as t7; alias names cannot establish semantic equivalence.
Text links, recycle state, editType, unbounded offsets, padding/border/background fields exceed initial basic text scope.
Creator comments require width/height/textSize in data coordinates, not view pixels. Actual source transform consumers remain unverified.

PageFragment applies textContent and global size/color, then range lists color, fontSize, typefaceData, underline, bold, italic; finally setAlignment(alignment) and setRowSpace(rowSpace). This is source call order, not verified TextViewUtil span precedence or packaged binary equivalence.
decision: Keep basic text design separate from lossless legacy migration. Do not flatten overlapping style lists or rename aliases by intuition; unsupported content requires explicit preservation/degradation reporting.
scope: Three source files inspected read-only and bound to current Git bytes.
